scripts.build: npm run build -w story-spec -w create-story-spec && npm rebuild story-spec
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w story-spec && npm run check -w template && npm exec -w template -- story-spec sync --check && npm run check:self
scripts.lint:package: publint packages/story-spec && publint packages/create-story-spec && attw --pack packages/story-spec --profile esm-only
scripts.version: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only && npm run build && cd template && story-spec sync
